tagline.en: Harrisburg to the Holland Tunnel, delayed by a reservation
tagline.zh: 从哈里斯堡到荷兰隧道，因一片保留地而延宕

mileageSource: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026

start.en: I-81 in Union Township, Lebanon County, Pennsylvania
start.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州黎巴嫩县联合镇，与 I-81 相接

end.en: The Holland Tunnel at Canal Street, Manhattan, New York City
end.zh: 纽约市曼哈顿运河街，荷兰隧道

en: I-78 is the short, heavily used connection between central Pennsylvania and the port and tunnel side of New York. It starts at I-81 north-east of Harrisburg, runs east along the base of the Blue Mountain through Allentown and Bethlehem, crosses the Delaware near Phillipsburg, traverses the Watchung Mountains and the New Jersey suburbs, and finishes at the Holland Tunnel.

For most of its length it is the successor to US 22, and it carries the freight that US 22 used to. The Lehigh Valley at its midpoint has become one of the largest warehouse and distribution clusters on the East Coast, and I-78 is the road that cluster is built around.

The last few miles are unlike the rest: elevated structure across Newark and the Meadowlands, a high arch bridge over Newark Bay on the New Jersey Turnpike extension, and then three blocks of city street in Jersey City before the tunnel portal.
zh: I-78 是宾夕法尼亚州中部与纽约港口、隧道一侧之间一条短而繁忙的连接线。它起自哈里斯堡东北的 I-81，沿蓝山山麓向东，经阿伦敦与伯利恒，在菲利普斯堡附近跨过特拉华河，穿过沃昌山与新泽西郊区，终点是荷兰隧道。
它大部分路段都是 US 22 的继任者，承担着原本属于 US 22 的货运。位于中点的利哈伊谷如今已成为东海岸最大的仓储与配送集群之一，而 I-78 正是这一集群赖以成立的那条路。
最后几英里与其余路段截然不同：横跨纽瓦克与草甸地的高架结构、新泽西收费高速延伸线上跨越纽瓦克湾的高拱桥，然后是泽西城的三个街区平面道路，再进入隧道口。

en: Parts of the route are much older than the number. The Holland Tunnel opened in 1927; the New Jersey Turnpike's Newark Bay Extension, which I-78 uses to reach it, opened in 1956. The Interstate designation was applied in 1958 to a highway planned broadly along US 22, and the New Jersey sections were built through the 1960s and 1970s.

Two disputes held the road up for two decades. The first was the Watchung Reservation, a two-thousand-acre county park in Union County. Environmental and local opposition, reinforced by the environmental review requirements introduced around 1970, delayed the segment between Springfield and Berkeley Heights by more than ten years. Once construction actually began it took less than four years, and Governor Kean opened the section in August 1986.

The second was Phillipsburg. Warren County residents defeated a plan to run I-78 through the town on the US 22 line in 1968, and in 1969 New Jersey and Pennsylvania agreed on a new alignment south of Allentown and Bethlehem with a new toll bridge over the Delaware. That bridge and its approaches opened on 21 November 1989, completing the route.
zh: 这条路线有些部分远比它的编号古老。荷兰隧道于 1927 年通车；I-78 借以抵达隧道的新泽西收费高速纽瓦克湾延伸线于 1956 年通车。1958 年，这一大体沿 US 22 规划的公路获得州际公路编号，新泽西州境内路段在 1960 与 1970 年代陆续建成。
两场争议把这条路拖了二十年。第一场围绕沃昌保留地——尤宁县一处两千英亩的县立公园。环保团体与地方的反对，加上 1970 年前后引入的环境审查要求，使斯普林菲尔德至伯克利海茨路段推迟了十年以上。真正开工后不到四年即完成，基恩州长于 1986 年 8 月主持通车。
第二场围绕菲利普斯堡。1968 年，沃伦县居民否决了让 I-78 沿 US 22 线穿城而过的方案；1969 年，新泽西与宾夕法尼亚两州商定改走阿伦敦、伯利恒以南的新线位，并新建一座跨特拉华河的收费桥。该桥及其引道于 1989 年 11 月 21 日通车，全线告成。

en: The Watchung Reservation crossing is the part worth looking at. Rather than cut a trench through the park, the designers split the two carriageways to different levels to follow the hillside, roofed three sections at Nikesite Road, W. R. Tracy Drive and Glenside Avenue so that park users and animals could cross over the top, and used brown sign and light posts, sound barriers and runoff catch basins to reduce the road's presence.

It was an expensive way to build a freeway and it was the price of building one at all. The mitigation did not solve everything — the state later paid to dredge construction sediment out of Lake Surprise — but the segment went in without the park being severed.
zh: 值得一看的是穿越沃昌保留地的那一段。设计者没有在公园里开一道堑壕，而是把两幅车行道分置于不同标高以顺应山坡，并在 Nikesite Road、W. R. Tracy Drive 与 Glenside Avenue 三处加盖顶板，使游人与动物可以从上方通过；同时采用棕色的标志杆与灯杆、声屏障与径流集水池，以降低道路的存在感。
这是一种昂贵的高速公路修法，而这正是「能修成」的代价。这些缓解措施并未解决所有问题——该州后来还出钱清挖了 Surprise 湖底的施工淤积物——但这一段建成时，公园并没有被切断。

value.en: About $111 million for 5.5 miles, opened in August 1986
value.zh: 5.5 英里，造价约 1.11 亿美元，1986 年 8 月通车

value.en: 146.24 miles: 77.50 in Pennsylvania, 67.84 in New Jersey and 0.90 in New York
value.zh: 146.24 英里：宾夕法尼亚州 77.50 英里，新泽西州 67.84 英里，纽约州 0.90 英里

figures.source: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026

why.en: Counts are published segment by segment by two state DOTs and by the toll authorities that operate the Newark Bay Extension and the Holland Tunnel. No single route-wide figure exists.
why.zh: 交通量由两个州的交通部门以及经营纽瓦克湾延伸线与荷兰隧道的收费机构分段发布。不存在单一的全线数字。

label.en: I-78 Toll Bridge over the Delaware
label.zh: 跨特拉华河的 I-78 收费桥

value.en: Twin four-girder, seven-span continuous structures, 1,222 feet overall, on hammerhead reinforced-concrete piers; opened 21 November 1989
value.zh: 双幅四主梁七跨连续结构，总长 1,222 英尺，支承于锤头形钢筋混凝土桥墩上；1989 年 11 月 21 日通车

conditionFigures.source: Delaware River Joint Toll Bridge Commission, I-78 Toll Bridge

timeline.en: The Holland Tunnel opens, later becoming the eastern end of I-78.
timeline.zh: 荷兰隧道通车，后成为 I-78 的东端。

timeline.en: The New Jersey Turnpike's Newark Bay Extension opens, carrying I-78 to the tunnel approaches.
timeline.zh: 新泽西收费高速纽瓦克湾延伸线通车，承载 I-78 通往隧道引道。

timeline.en: I-78 is designated along a line broadly following US 22.
timeline.zh: I-78 沿大体循 US 22 的走向定名。

timeline.en: The 5.5-mile 'missing link' through the Watchung Reservation opens in August after more than a decade of delay.
timeline.zh: 8 月，穿越沃昌保留地的 5.5 英里「缺失环节」在延宕十余年后通车。

timeline.en: The Delaware toll bridge and its approaches open on 21 November, completing the route.
timeline.zh: 11 月 21 日，特拉华河收费桥及其引道通车，全线告成。
